tool_args.rationale: The authorized source note and shared-subtree guidance give a specific three-parameter law, parameter scale, and square-root branch; five pilot rows with broad s_grad span are stated to identify those parameters. Fit them numerically using all paid observations, with tau_scale=4 and the provided wide fallback bounds, avoiding an unnecessary probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The supplied matched-subtree guidance identifies the square-root branch as the open completion and states the five pilot rows identify its three parameters; fitting the specified completion is lower cost than another measurement.
No temporal signature or long-horizon regime is indicated; the target horizon is 0.6 and the verified mechanism is a reduced slow-ODE readout.
Both conflict with the supplied matched two-layer siphon subtree and its explicit branch rule; the observed concave response is consistent with the selected completion.
It is unrelated to the identified three-parameter target law and is explicitly not warranted.
